The '''Sketto Canyon Bend''' was the last part of the [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] course known as [[Sebulba's Legacy/Legends|Sebulba's Legacy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. The canyon featured two distinct parts, a straight left path and a lower, harder to navigate right path.
